blocks.text: Make room for extraordinary adventures and memorable holiday escapes as Jpark Island Resort & Waterpark brings its much-awaited Nationwide Year-End Sale to major shopping destinations across the Philippines from November 27 to 29, 2026, offering guests up to 45% OFF and other exclusive deals on their next island getaway. As one of the country’s premier 5-star waterpark resort destinations, Jpark Island Resorts & Waterpark continues to redefine the ultimate island getaway by bringing together luxury, leisure, entertainment, and world-class Filipino hospitality in one exceptional destination. Situated along the pristine shores of Mactan Island, Cebu, the resort offers an immersive vacation experience for families, couples, […]...
